won.sql: SELECT a.segment AS segment, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS accts FROM crm.deals d JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_at >= $since GROUP BY a.segment

all.sql: SELECT a.segment AS segment, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS accts FROM crm.deals d JOIN crm.accounts a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.stage <> 'open' AND d.closed_at >= $since GROUP BY a.segment
